definitions.explanation: The night before today. Can also be read as ゆうべ.

examples.japanese: {昨夜|さくや}は{よく|よく}{眠|ねむ}れた。
{昨夜|さくや}のパーティーは{楽|たの}しかった。
{昨夜|さくや}から{雨|あめ}が{降|ふ}っている。
examples.english: It's been raining since last night.

examples.japanese: {昨夜|さくや}は{友人|ゆうじん}と{遅|おそ}くまで{話|はな}していた。
examples.english: Last night, I was talking with a friend until late.

examples.japanese: {昨夜|さくや}{見|み}た{映画|えいが}がとても{面白|おもしろ}かったので、{友達|ともだち}にもすすめた。
examples.english: The movie I saw last night was so interesting that I recommended it to my friends.

notes:
{昨夜|さくや} means "last night". This word has two readings.

READINGS:
- さくや: formal/written
- ゆうべ: casual/spoken

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {昨夜|さくや}の{出来事|できごと} (events of last night)
- {昨夜|さくや}から (since last night)

RELATED TIME WORDS:
- {今夜|こんや}: tonight
- {昨日|きのう}: yesterday
- {夕べ|ゆうべ}: last night (alternative writing)
